subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding factors as numbers that divide evenly into another number
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges virtual objects into equal rows/columns (arrays) to find factor pairs
exercise.pictorial: Student matches pictured arrays to their factor pair
exercise.abstract: Student lists all factors of a given number

misconception_flags: misses 1 and the number itself as factors

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
